name: Michelle Cheung
source: A young professional living in Hong Kong. She has lived a relatively sheltered life, thanks in part to her conservative mother, and her life is little more than a routine of home, work, and back again. She is content with her life and one day knows she will marry a suitable man and settle into a perfectly acceptable life as a wife and mother—but fate has other plans.
